observations: Black and red exercise spinning bike shown in an indoor room on tiled floor
Flywheel area has text reading 'FITNESS' in white/red lettering
Handlebars have multiple grip positions typical of spin bikes, with a small phone/tablet holder mounted on top
A watermark reads 'POSTED ON SITE' and 'AMERICAN SPORT LIMITED' across the image
No visible brand nameplate, model number, or specification sticker
Single photo only, no close-up of flywheel weight, resistance knob, or frame joints
Floor and wall in background suggest a home or showroom setting, not clearly a shop

claims.evidence: No spec sticker, flywheel weight marking, or commercial-grade certification visible in photo 0; 'semi commercial' is a quality/durability claim that cannot be confirmed from a single exterior photo

risks.risk: Flywheel weight and build quality (determines if it is truly 'semi commercial' grade or a lighter home unit)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of flywheel with any stamped weight/spec label, or a maker's nameplate
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard home-use spinning bike, not semi commercial

risks.risk: Resistance mechanism condition (friction pad or magnetic) and smoothness of pedal action
risks.proof: Short video clip of the bike being pedaled showing resistance adjustment in use
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case functional risk

risks.risk: Seat and handlebar adjustment mechanisms (rust, stripped threads, missing knobs)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat post clamp and handlebar stem adjusters
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming adjusters may be faulty or missing

risks.risk: Console/display functionality (if any) for tracking speed, time, calories
risks.proof: Photo or video of console screen powered on

risks.risk: Frame stability and welds (hidden cracks, wobble under load)
risks.proof: Photo from a low angle showing frame base and welded joints, plus a clip of bike in use without wobble

proof_requests: Close-up of any brand/model nameplate or spec sticker on the frame or flywheel
Short video of the bike being pedaled with resistance knob being turned
Close-up of seat and handlebar adjustment clamps
Photo of console/display screen if present, powered on
Wider shot or additional angle showing full frame and base for structural assessment
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a spinning/exercise bike, but the 'semi commercial' claim and functional condition are unverifiable from a single photo, so it must be priced at the worst-case home-use, unconfirmed-working condition until further proof is supplied.
